correctness.rationale: The enriched-poset antichains lie wholly in one of the two incomparable levels. The support function is max of the two sums of absolute Gaussian coordinates; ties have probability zero, and conditional signs give vertex masses 2^{-p}rho and 2^{-q}(1-rho). Sum squared masses yields exact collision C2. The difference of half-normal sums has finite smooth cumulant generating function and positive mean for alpha>1/2, so exponential tilt establishes the rate I(alpha) for the losing block. Inserting rates yields min(alpha log 2,(1-alpha)log 2+2I). I is strictly convex, I(1/2)=Iprime(1/2)=0 and diverges near 1, so the strict convex crossing exists exactly once. The 3D orthant calculation establishes rho(2,1).
residual_risks: Standard coordinate metric, complete two-level ordinal antichain sum p+q=N, alpha in (1/2,1). No statement at alpha=alpha* on relative subexponential prefactors, no unrestricted posets/affine images or higher collision moments.
